name: The Langham, Chicago
insider_take: This Mies van der Rohe-designed tower transforms IBM's former Midwest headquarters into Chicago's most architecturally significant luxury hotel.
whats_special: The hotel occupies the first 13 floors of a modernist masterpiece, where original terrazzo floors and floor-to-ceiling windows showcase the legendary architect's "less is more" philosophy. The Pavilion penthouse bar offers 360-degree city views from what was once IBM's executive boardroom.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on floors 8-12 for unobstructed views of the Chicago River and Marina City's iconic "corn cob" towers—a photographer's dream, especially at sunset.
dont_miss: The Chuan Spa's "Chicago Skyline" treatment room with floor-to-ceiling windows, and Travelle's modern American cuisine featuring locally-sourced ingredients from Chicago's Green City Market, just blocks away.
pros: Prime River North location with stunning Chicago River and skyline views
Award-winning Chuan Spa offering traditional Chinese wellness treatments
Luxurious accommodations with marble bathrooms and premium amenities
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may feel less casual for some guests
